title: Deeper/broader DXF text-route and writer-integrity cross-check
scope: Target DXF string transport versus source DWG TV/TU storage path
Peer writer failures in text framing, block enumeration, INSERT attribute sequences, and numeric precision
Readiness crosswalk to existing PAR-05/PAR-74/PAR-85/7AR, PAR-43/7Y, block-owner, and 7AS.2/PAR-78 tests

method.kind: Read-only web review of Autodesk's DXF string contract, LibreDWG issue/source documentation, ACadSharp issue/PR, and local plan/source/test inventory
method.limitations: LibreDWG #1414 is an open reporter analysis, not an independently reproduced or normative result. ACadSharp #1179 is linked to a closed PR, but the selected current formal release artifact was not inspected for the fix. Peer block/sequence/text reports are not evidence of matching libdxfrw defects. No external source files were downloaded.

sources.observed: R2007+ DXF strings use UTF-8; R2004 and earlier use ASCII plus CIF/MIF forms. The selected output DXF version is the target transport axis.

The reporter identifies different VALUE_TV and VALUE_TU DXF output behavior for escape expansion and asks whether target-version or source-storage behavior is intended. The report notes lone-surrogate risk; no independent reproduction was performed.

The documentation distinguishes pre-R2007 code-page TV/T strings from R2007+ UCS-2 TU/T strings and describes conversion through UTF-8/CIF/MIF, but does not independently settle the reported output-path inconsistency.
A reporter describes raw CR inside text causing malformed physical DXF group framing and a dropped adjacent character.
A reporter attributes skipped BLOCK_HEADER records and empty block bodies to mutation of an outer loop index during per-block writing.

sources.revision: issue body and reported master status reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: A reporter found INSERT group 66=1 with no ATTRIB/SEQEND output in a malformed source ownership case and later reported a peer master fix. This remains historical peer evidence, not a current peer defect or local reproduction.
A peer DXF writer issue reports 15-significant-digit ASCII double output and loss of exact binary64 readback. Its linked closed fix was not verified in a selected release artifact.

assessment.targetTransportRule: Test encoding as a function of output DXF target version; source DWG TV/TU storage is an independent input-path axis.
assessment.semanticRule: Compare decoded semantic strings separately from raw target bytes and preserve field-specific meaning for ordinary strings, MTEXT controls, and XRECORD payloads.
assessment.peerEvidenceRule: Peer issue bodies generate test shapes but do not establish local defects or normative file-format rules.
assessment.existingLocalCrosswalk: Local plan already covers PAR-43 exact numeric formatting, 7M control-character policy, per-identity/per-owner output disposition, and 7AS.2/PAR-78 INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND framing. The missing explicit source-storage × target-version matrix should be audited within the existing text owners before adding tests.
